Fall Alert - My Medic Watch is a ground-breaking smartwatch app which uses proprietary and innovative algorithms to interpret data captured by smartwatch sensor technologies. By using innovative algorithms, it automatically detects if the wearer has a fall and activates immediate emergency assistance.

My Medic Watch provides monthly and yearly subscriptions which include a 30-day free trial.

We do not sell or provide smartwatches, but rather our app is compatible with many commercially available smartwatches, view our compatible smartwatch options at https://www.mymedicwatch.com/smartwatches/

Today, more and more people are choosing to live independently, in their own homes, aided by vital technology innovations like Fall Alert - My Medic Watch, which was validated by medical trials undertaken in Sydney. 

Fall Alert - My Medic Watch is designed to be downloaded to a wearable device. It can be worn by people of all ages who are prone to falls.

If the wearer does have a fall, Fall Alert - My Medic Watch automatically detects it and notifies all nominated caregivers, without the need for manual intervention, providing details of the user’s location. The app can also be activated manually by the wearer if they are feeling unwell and require assistance, simply by pressing a button on their smartwatch.

This process has four steps:

1. Smart Detection: As soon as a fall occurs, Fall Alert - My Medic Watch detects it using smartwatch sensors and an accurate algorithm.

2. Immediate Alert: The app then automatically sends notifications with the wearer’s GPS location to the nominated caregivers without the need for manual intervention based on workflows of escalation.

3. Reassurance for Everyone: All caregivers are sent updates of the progress, keeping everyone informed and reassured.

4. Real-Time Data: Included in the user’s subscription is access to real-time data for all related medical episodes. The user can also choose to give access to his or her doctor, so that their medical data can be reviewed securely, online. The App uses HealthKit to save and store the user's heart rate during the medical episode.

Thanks to Fall Alert - My Medic Watch, those with a condition that makes them susceptible to falls, can continue to live independently in their own homes, with ultimate peace of mind.

App subscription information:

With the Fall Alert - My Medic Watch app subscriptions, the wearer has their smartwatch app running and benefit from being monitored all the time with automatic fall detection. These app subscriptions include automatic medical event app notifications.

results.description:
FallGuard keeps your family safe by detecting falls and streaming live vitals from your loved one's Apple Watch to your phone — instantly.

ALERTS THAT GET THROUGH
A fall alert can reach you even when your phone is silenced or in Do Not Disturb. Most apps go quiet at night — the one time a fall is most likely to go unnoticed. FallGuard doesn't. You'll be asked once whether to allow this, and you can turn it off anytime.

LIVE VITALS, ON YOUR DASHBOARD
See heart rate, breathing, and blood oxygen as the watch reads them. Open the app and the latest readings are waiting for you.

CUSTOM ALERT LEVELS
Set the limits that matter for the person you're watching over. Heart rate above 100? Below 50? Oxygen below 92%? Their watch fires an alert the moment any value crosses your threshold — no waiting hours for the next summary.

FALL DETECTION
When the wearer's Apple Watch detects a fall, FallGuard immediately sends an urgent push notification with the time and GPS location to all caregivers. No checking email, no delays — an instant alert right on your iPhone.

ONE PERSON, ONE CARD
The redesigned dashboard shows a big card for each person you're watching over — their name, status, and last update at a glance. Tap a card for full details.

SIMPLE SETUP
Pick whether you're wearing the watch or someone else is, and the app shows you the right experience. Add a person with their family code and you're done — no jargon, no menus to dig through.

WHO IT'S FOR
Adult children watching over aging parents. Caregivers monitoring patients. Anyone who wants real-time visibility into a family member's health and safety, without waking up at night wondering if they're okay.

PRIVACY
Vitals data only flows to caregivers who joined with your family code. Apple Watch handles fall detection and emergency calling at the OS level — FallGuard never replaces that, only supplements it with family-side awareness.

REQUIREMENTS
• An Apple Watch with watchOS 10 or later for the wearer
• An iPhone running iOS 17 or later for caregivers
• HealthKit and Notifications permissions

We'd love your feedback. Reach us at support@fallguard.me.

A FULL DAY OF HEALTH, NOT JUST A MOMENT
FallGuard records vitals throughout the day and keeps a history, so you can see trends over time — not just a single stale reading. Compare this week to last to catch changes early.

KNOW THE WATCH IS WORKING
See at a glance whether the watch is worn, off, or charging, plus its battery and your loved one's phone battery — so you always know whether "no update" means all is well or the watch just needs putting on.
